citations.assessment: Arukh directly gives כעדי and describes Adi as known in his generation and careful in commandments.
Megillah and the checked Rashi omit כעדי at this locus. Rashi explains nimos as a designation; Heilprin attributes an express exclusion to a Rashi witness.

holds.reason: The checked Bavli and Rashi omit the term, while Arukh expressly includes it. The exact Rashi witness with the explicit rejection remains to collate.
Exact alternate gloss by Pinto in the relevant printing remains uncollated.
